items.quote: I had an excellent experience with Ochoa Electric Services. David showed up right on time, which already put me at ease. He was professional, extremely knowledgeable, and took the time to walk me through everything in a way that made sense.
We have used David with Ochoa Electric on several occasions. They have installed new recessed lighting, added new outlets, swapped out old outlets, and added a whole lot more.

I was pleasantly surprised to meet an authentic service man in David Ochoa. I thought I had a bigger issue with my outlets, and he gave me a lesson on how these work. And he did not charge me. Grateful for meeting a trustworthy company.
